target_rule: Retained right-camera pixel [365,256], at most 2px refinement on each fresh legal RGB-D capture
approach: run_grounded_correction with pause-before-close and contact-tracking-guard; conservative continuous transit
closure: probe_contact_stage: close, 64 actions maximum, strict arrival required
lift: run_sensor_carry: four upward segments to sensor-derived grasp endpoint +0.23m, hold the condition aperture
physical_outcome: Independent review of both external RGB views for card retention and support clearance; endpoint receipt alone is insufficient
stop_rule: No retry after guard, rejected/ambiguous execution or out-of-bounds completion. Do not run second condition if first fails closure, bounded lift completion or visual retention.
